• Typed state saved to PostgreSQL after every step (resumes after a crash).
• Pauses at the approval interrupt; Edit → re-verify, Approve → finalize.
• Timeouts and retries per agent; if verification fails, nothing is released.
Runs on every chat answer, every draft and any pasted text
• Steps 1–5, 7, 8 are database lookups and string matching: they cannot hallucinate.
• Only step 6 uses AI, and its answer is rejected unless it quotes the judgment.
• “Not found” means not in our library — never “fake”.
